title: CryptoCellar Enigma Messages and Keys — HELUT Tier 2 reference library
license_note: Catalog of publicly documented authentic messages and key sheets (Weierud / Sullivan / Erskine et al.). Used for validation research; PDF key sheets are linked, not OCR'd here.

messages_and_decrypts.title: Authentic German Army Test Message from 1930
messages_and_decrypts.notes: Umkehrwalze A; message key ABL recovered from indicator at Grundstellung FOL. Same vector as Franklin Heath.

messages_and_decrypts.title: Authentic German Army Enigma Decrypt (Turing Bombe article)
messages_and_decrypts.notes: Three-part teleprinter FRX, 21 Sep 1938 (not 1939). Message keys AGI / YBE / LUN in pencil. Full daily key not asserted in HELUT until independently verified.

messages_and_decrypts.title: Authentic German Navy Enigma Decrypt (Dolphin / Hydra)
messages_and_decrypts.notes: Ralph Erskine challenge message (Apr 1944). Plaintext published; key withheld as a break exercise.

messages_and_decrypts.title: Authentic German Navy Enigma M4 Messages
messages_and_decrypts.notes: Shark/Triton, Turtle/Medusa, Pike/Aegir ciphertexts for the M4 Message Breaking Project. Requires 4-rotor oracle.

messages_and_decrypts.title: Scharnhorst’s Last Message?
messages_and_decrypts.notes: Broken by M4 Project 2008. UKW B, wheels 368, rings AHM, key UZV, 10 steckers. Indicators UTKZ RBSB …

messages_and_decrypts.title: Large Number of Authentic Enigma Messages (BGAC portal)
messages_and_decrypts.notes: Index into Army Group / Wehrmacht collections and break reports.

messages_and_decrypts.title: Authentic Wehrmacht (SS) Enigma Decrypts — Flossenbürg
messages_and_decrypts.notes: 258 KL Flossenbürg messages; keys published in per-message PDFs on that site.

wehrmacht_keys.title: Schlüsseleinsatz — Ciphers in use during Jan–May 1945

army_keys.title: Sonder-Maschinenschlüssel BHI / BHJ (archive mix-up)
army_keys.notes: Envelope labeled BHI serial 2; sheet is BHJ serial 3.
